description.zh-CN: 中文圈开源个人 AI 助手与 Agent 底座（前 chatgpt-on-wechat）：桌面客户端开箱即用，网页控制台一站式聊天、连接微信/Telegram/Discord 等渠道、一键安装技能；模型随便换（OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、通义……）。
description.en: Open-source personal AI assistant and agent harness from the Chinese dev community (formerly chatgpt-on-wechat): a ready-to-run desktop client plus a one-stop web console for chatting, connecting channels (WeChat, Telegram, Discord…) and one-click skills; swap models freely (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen…).

runtime.note: Desktop client: Electron shell + PyInstaller Python backend bundled inside the app — no system Python/Node for the GUI route. The alternative one-line service installer (manual route in the guide) needs Python 3.7+ and installs into a folder of your choice.

custom.label: Custom / local OpenAI-compatible endpoint
custom.notes: The official model table lists a Custom row for local models and third-party proxies (Ollama, vLLM…); pick it in the console and point it at your endpoint — no key needed for open local servers.

upgrade.notes: Check = local probe vs the upstream latest tag the daily probe records (releases/latest, measured by CI); upgrade = re-run the installer (NSIS overwrite install / dmg replace) or use the in-app update prompt. The one-line service route upgrades with `cow update`.

steps: Windows: Settings → Apps → CowAgent → Uninstall (NSIS uninstaller, per-user)
macOS: quit CowAgent and move CowAgent.app to the Trash
Back up then remove the app data folder if you want a clean slate (chat records, model keys, skills live there)
uninstall.notes: Uninstalling the app does not delete user data by design — dataPaths above are removed manually after backup; the one-line service route additionally lives in its install folder (config.json + logs) which is deleted by removing that folder.

risk.onUninstall: 聊天记录、模型 API Key、已装技能等应用数据在系统应用数据目录里，卸载程序不会删它们，但手动清掉就找不回来了——请先备份 / Chat history, model API keys and installed skills live in the app data folder; the uninstaller keeps them, but deleting the folder loses them for good — back up first.
